parts.html: The K-12 kitchen is an L-shaped model in a modern style: beige fronts with a wood decor and simply shaped cabinets.
Light beige keeps the L-shaped kitchen from feeling heavy and sits calmly next to light walls and stone.
The K-12 fronts are made of two materials: foil-wrapped uppers and laminated chipboard lowers. The wood decor is the same on both.
The 5.4-linear-meter kitchen takes up two adjoining walls. There is no island, so a dining table fits in the same room.
The hinges are Hettich soft-close, and the drawer slides are concealed Muller slides.
Hinge type: Hettich with soft-close mechanism

We handle everything for the K-12 ourselves: the design for your dimensions and appliances, manufacturing in our own workshop in Bratislava, delivery, and installation. The price is the same for Bratislava and Vienna.
